pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa pariveṇavāsikā bhikkhuniyo yāguyā kilamanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.3: athakho so pūgo bhikkhunīnaṃ yāguatthāya chandakaṃ saṅgharitvā aññatarassa āpaṇikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.4: amukassa ayye āpaṇikassa ghare yāguatthāya parikkhāro nikkhitto tato taṇḍule āharāpetvā yāguṃ pacāpetvā paribhuñjathāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.5: bhikkhuniyo tena parikkhārena bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.6: so pūgo jānitvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpessantīti. assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa upāsakassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa. yā tā bhikkhu niyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.10: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.12: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.15: idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.19.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.20: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np8:2.21: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
